DECLARATION,RESTRICTIVECOVENANTANDAGREEMENT THIS DECLARATION, RESTRICTIVE  COVENANT AND AGREEMENT (this "Agreement) is made as of the " day of febay2015 by and between PRINCE STREET LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 1735 Park Avenue, New York, NY 10035 ("Declarant"), and 261 BROADWAY INVESTORS LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (together with its successors and assigns, “Beneficiary"), having an address at c/o The Klein Group, 25A Hanover Road, Suite 350, Florham Park, NJ 07932. WITNESSETH WHEREAS, on the date hereof, Beneficiary and 261 Broadway Air LLC,a Delaware limited liability company ("Air” and, together with Beneficiary, collectively, “Seller") have conveyed to Declarant the premises known as The Commercial Condominium Unit (the “Unit") in the premises known as 261 Broadway, Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, said Unit being designated and described as the Commercial Unit in the Declaration establishing a plan for condominium ownership of The 261 Broadway Condominium (the "Condominium") under Article 9-B of the Real Property Law of the State of New York, dated September 10, 1979 and recorded against the land (the “Land") more particularly described on Schedule 1 attached hereto and made a part hereof in the New York County Office of the Register of The City of New York on September 28, 1979 (the “Declaration") and also designated as Tax Lot 1001 in Block 135 of the Borough of Manhattan on the Tax Map of the Real Property Assessment Department of The City of New York, together with an undivided 20.00% interest in the Common Elements (as such term is defined in the Declaration), all as more fully described on Schedule 2 attached hereto (the “Premises"); WHEREAS, the conveyance of the Premises to Declarant expressly excludes and WHEREAS,to further evidence and confirm (i) the exclusion of the Unit's DR Interests from Seller's conveyance of the Premises to Declarant, (i) restrictions on the rights of Declarant and any successors and/or assigns of Declarant as owner of the Premises with respect to the respect to the Unit's DR Interests, Declarant and Beneficiary are entering into this Agreement. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, Declarant and Beneficiary do herebycovenant and agreethat: 1.Definitions. As used in this Agreement: (a) undefined terms used herein, which are defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, as in effect as of the date hereof (the “Zoning Resolution") -- such as, without limitation, the terms “parties in interest", “floor area," “floor area ratio, "lot area," "party in interest,"and “zoning lot”-- shall be defined and construed as those terms are defined in and construed pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution; 442619-8-W

(b) the term “Development Rights” shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution,which are appurtenant to a zoninglot, to develop the zoninglotbyerectingoraddingthereonastructureorstructureswithatotalfloorarea determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the floor area ratio established for the zoningdistrict or districtsinwhichthezoninglotis located,(ii)theinclusionof anybonusfloor area available to the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and (ii) the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density, and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of New York from time to time; (c) the term “Condo Development Rights" shall mean any and all Development Rights appurtenant to the Land and the Building (each, as defined in the Declaration) or otherwise owned or controlled by the Condominium (or by the Unit Owners pursuant to the Declaration), and the term “Unused Condo Development Rights” shall mean any floor area or Condo Development Rights which are not utilized by the Building or any other improvements existing ontheLand;and (d)  the “Unit's DR Interests" shall mean, collectively: (x) any and all consent and authority rights under the Declaration,the By-Laws (as defined in the Declaration) and/or by law held by or appurtenant to the owner of the Unit and its interest in the Common Elements with respect to the use, sale or disposition of Unused Condo Development Rights (hereinafter defined), and (y) all rights held by or appurtenant to the owner of the Unit to receive the 2.Rights of Beneficiary with Respect to Unused Condo Development Rights.Declarant andBeneficiary acknowledge and agree that: (a) The Premises conveyed by Seller to Declarant expressly exclude the Unit's DR Interests. (b)Declarant shall have no right to (i) represent the Unit's DR Interests in any dealings with the Condominium or any third parties regarding any the use of or any prospective sale or transfer of Unused Condo Development Rights, including granting or withholding any consents to the Condominium or and/or the Board of Managers on behalf of the Unit to any such sale or disposition and executing any documents orinstruments required in connectionwith any such sale or disposition, and/or (ii) receive any proceeds of any sale or disposition of Unused Condo Development Rights which are applicable to the Unit (collectively, “DR Sales Proceeds"). ()  Declarant shall not (and shall not permit any tenant or other occupant of the Unit to) take or omit to take any action which would use, diminish, restrict or encumber any Unused CondoDevelopmentRights.
